verdicts.why: Transcript: Scott and Jean challenge Xavier over handing the school to Magneto and he says he wanted them free to be a family; Cyclops's Blue Team goes with Xavier to Asteroid M.

value.title: X-Men '97#9
value.text: Xavier asks Logan to blame him, not Magneto, for the crisis. On Asteroid M, after Logan stabs Magneto, Xavier begs Magneto to stop as he rips the adamantium from Logan's body.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man. Wants Magneto dead for the blackout.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader. Begs Magneto to stop tearing out his adamantium.

verdicts.why: Xavier talks Logan down at the gathering on Earth ('Logan, if you must punish someone for today, then start with me'), not on Asteroid M, where Logan stabs Magneto anyway and Xavier begs Magneto to stop.
Transcript: Rogue tells Xavier he should have seen them as people, he answers 'I'm so sorry, Rogue', and she then goes to Asteroid M with Magneto.
Transcript: over the unconscious Wolverine, Cyclops says 'Don't you dare break her heart. Be the best at what you do. Heal.'
Transcript: Prime Sentinels attack at the school; Logan ('six reasons why') and Kurt fight them to keep them away from Rogue.
Transcript: Logan and Nightcrawler ('No, mein Freund. Nine!') fight the Prime Sentinels together to get them away from Rogue.
Transcript: Logan asks 'Why the heck didn't you stop Genosha?' and Cable explains he was pulled away in time every time he tried.
Recap: Rogue wakes with Nightcrawler in Mexico City, breaks down over Gambit, and Jean embraces her with the team present.
Transcript: Cyclops tells Storm to watch Magneto and the judges; when Jean goes into labor Storm sends Rogue to fly Cyclops to her.
Wikipedia #18: after Cable tries to kill the unconscious Gambit, Jubilee and Sunspot leave with the X-Men.
Wikipedia #19 and Marvel Database: Archangel is with X-Force at X-Corp, Apocalypse brainwashes everyone there, and Rogue frees them with her celestial power.
Recap and transcript #7: Jean senses a telepath under Genosha's rubble and Emma is pulled out alive in diamond form; a rescue with no further hostility makes ally a fair through-line.
No source shows a Cyclops and Havok exchange in X-Men '97; in #19 Havok fights Jubilee and Cyclops fights Cable, so they share only the battle.
Wikipedia #17: Beast is on the team that goes to the Savage Land to free the abducted Creed ('the man we're rescuin''), which counts as acting for him; enemy stays.
Wikipedia #9 and transcript: the Gold Team, Morph among them ('Morph smash!'), fights Bastion's Sentinels in the Galapagos.
Transcript #1: Trask tells the X-Men 'Gyrich warned me you were coming'. That line shows the two working together, and both are on screen in the episode.
Transcript #3: Morph says 'I can show you where he is' and Scott answers 'Fine. Lead the way.'
Wikipedia #8: Prime Sentinels attack Xavier's school, and in the transcript Logan fights them there.
Transcript #8: the butler Ford turns into a Prime Sentinel ('Surrender, mutants'), and Jubilee reacts to it in Roberto's home.
Transcript #13: Bishop tracks Nur down ('I found you'), knocks him out and moves to take the X-Men home.
Transcript #14: Beast recognizes the temple as Ship, the X-Men fight to keep Nur from the shrine, and Wikipedia says Beast uses Ship's parts to send them home after Nur becomes Apocalypse.
Wikipedia #19 and Marvel Database: Archangel attacks X-Corp with X-Force, and Apocalypse, loose in Gambit's body, brainwashes all of them until Rogue frees them.
Marvel Database: at the Metro Chemical factory Rogue tries to steal Magneto's power but cannot get close, and he disables the X-Men. Rogue is not in the #3 army base fight.
Marvel Database: while most of the X-Men go to Muir Island, Storm and Cyclops stay behind to care for Jean in Phoenix Saga Part III (#31).
Marvel Database: Magneto invites Xavier and his escorts Gambit and Beast onto Asteroid M, and after Cortez ejects Magneto, Gambit is jailed for his supposed murder.
Wikipedia #37 and Marvel Database: Xavier tells Jubilee about Iceman and Lorna, an early X-Man, and the X-Men find her in X-Factor. Both are on screen and the line shows they know each other.
Wikipedia #1 and Marvel Database: Storm, Rogue and Gambit fight off the Sentinel hunting Jubilee at the mall.
Wikipedia #35 and Marvel Database: Gambit is with the X-Men against Apocalypse, who says he set Archangel and the X-Men up to be rid of them.
Marvel Database #10: Rogue exposes Mystique on Muir Island, Apocalypse moves to exterminate her at Stonehenge, and she absorbs Archangel's dark side, breaking his conditioning.
Marvel Database #10: Apocalypse makes Archangel and War Horsemen, 'War and Archangel take down the French army', and Archangel then turns on the other Horsemen.
Wikipedia #35 and Marvel Database: Cyclops is with the X-Men who fight Apocalypse in Obsession, and Apocalypse says he set them all up to be rid of them.

The only exchange is between versions from an erased timeline: a 2055 Forge who does not know the four time travelers. The show treats it as undone: in X-Men '97#3 Forge introduces himself to Storm as a stranger.
Marvel Database #13: 'The X-Men' find Gyrich at the Lincoln Memorial, and Rogue is named only in the later Sentinel diversion. No source puts her in an exchange with Gyrich in the animated series.
Marvel Database: Ward, Fitz, Simmons and Skye go to the Academy over the freezing attacks, and Weaver meets and briefs them, with an on-screen exchange between Weaver, Ward and Skye.
Marvel Database: Simmons and Skye trick Lorelei into the interrogation room, where Sif confronts and collars her.
